query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
               FROM pictures p
               WHERE p.local_user_id = $1
                 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 AND (
                   p.last_pipeline_run_at IS NULL
                   OR EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM tagging_services ts
                     WHERE ts.owner_id = $1
                       AND ts.enabled = true
                       AND p.last_pipeline_run_at < ts.last_invalidated_at
                   )
                 )
